name: FedEx Express Regional Hub - Miami FL

fieldNotes.location: Airport air-cargo hub on the southwest cargo apron of Miami International Airport (MIA). The roster street address 7150 NW 25th St geocodes to a generic warehouse/lease park ~1.5 km west of the airport with no FedEx presence (Street View at NW 72nd Ave shows 'AVAILABLE' lease signs); the operational FedEx Express Americas-gateway hub is the airfield cargo distribution facility, a ~282,000 sq ft single building with airside aircraft apron and landside truck docks.
fieldNotes.buildingAttribution: MIA's cargo complex is shared by many carriers (a DHL building is confirmed by signage at the east end of the cargo row in 2022 Street View). The exact FedEx building could not be 100% confirmed by visible branding from Street View; identification rests on facility type, scale (~282K sq ft / ~30-acre site per PGAL/GRAEF project pages), and configuration (airside freighter apron + landside truck dock row). Confidence reduced to medium for this reason.
fieldNotes.truckGate: Airport cargo facilities are accessed via controlled airport cargo-service roads; entry to the Airport Operations Area / cargo zone is security-controlled (badge/credential check at the cargo-zone perimeter rather than a per-building gate). Counted as a controlled truck gate.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: No dedicated 1-3-vehicle guard booth at this individual building's truck driveway in imagery; access control is the airport cargo-zone credentialing process upstream. Marked remoteGs true (gate, no on-site shack).
fieldNotes.multiStep: Airport cargo zone access is multi-stage by nature: airport security/credential checkpoint at the cargo-area perimeter, then the building's own dock dispatch. Low confidence.
fieldNotes.dockDoorCount: ~50-60 dock doors estimated along the long landside face from z18-z19 imagery; regular bay rhythm with trailers backed in. Honest overhead estimate.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Trailers staged in the strip in front of the dock row and in a side parking area; estimated 10-25 drop trailers.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: ~30 acres per PGAL/GRAEF FedEx Cargo Distribution Center Expansion project descriptions (17 acres of site development on a 30-acre site).
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur; airport air-cargo facility.
